hints.title: Flexible Boundary Cut
hints.text: Consider partitions with single cell offsets or boundary adjustments between two segments.

hints.title: Difference Target Matching
hints.text: When top and bottom partial sums differ, a single cell of value equal to the difference can balance the partition.

hints.title: Symmetry Reduction
hints.text: Check all four orientations by rotating and reversing rows/columns through transposed views.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Four directional checks using hash sets of encountered cell values.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all possible cut shapes incurs exponential combinations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Set lookups verify difference balance in O(1) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use symmetry transformations to reduce code redundancy.
